newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian INA, Samsung agree to extend cooperation.
newsitem.headline: Croatian INA, Samsung agree to extend cooperation.

text.p: Croatia's state oil company INA Industrija Nafte and Samsung Corp on Monday agreed to extend mutual cooperation.
They signed a letter of intent for expanding business in three main fields, INA said in a statement faxed to Reuters without mentioning any figure for the proposed deals.
INA will be supplying oil derivatives to Samsung but precise quantities and prices still have to be agreed. The two companies will also cooperate in processing of oil derivatives, it said.
Between 1998 and 2007 Samsung planned to use INA's Rijeka refinery capacities to process up to 500,000 tonnes of crude.
Both companies also aimed to invest in the modernisation of the Rijeka port -- Croatia's largest but no further details were available.
